decisions.reason: A newly launched IMU module in a modular building-block platform costs little to keep in stock and produce in-house, and its prospects are still too uncertain after one year to justify abandoning it.
The industrial AC input module has its own dedicated page, fits the industrial automation direction, and is cheap to maintain, so keeping the option open is clearly worthwhile.
The four-channel solid state relay complements the firm's control portfolio, shares its platform architecture, and keeping it costs little while demand is still unfolding.
The server room monitoring kit bundles existing modules at minimal extra cost, so it remains a cheap option despite the shift toward standalone networked controllers.
